title: Probe and needle on the patient
view: The bare back of an adult sitting and leaning slightly forward, from directly behind: head at the top, the patient's right on the image right. Probe position after NYSORA's ESP photo (concept only).
teachingPoint: The probe stands sagittal about 3 cm from the spinous processes at T5, between the spine and the scapula; the needle enters at its upper end and runs cranial to caudal.
claims: Patient sitting (record: sitting or lateral decubitus); a gloved hand holds the probe (owner, 2026-10-15).
Probe sagittal about 3 cm lateral to the spinous processes (record), at T5 (NYSORA).
Needle in-plane from the cranial end of the probe (record: usually cranial to caudal).
Spinous processes about 24 mm apart from C7; scapular medial border about 7 cm from the midline, inferior angle near T7 (standard anatomy).
Labels: Linear probe, Block needle, Spinous processes (the scapula is not visible on the painting, so it is not labelled).
